single_core_variable: stably recover an observed same-object other-person event when answering a user-ownership memory query

comparison_design.uruha_memory: Fresh V2.22 UruhaBrain generation at five checkpoints.
comparison_design.v2_21_uruha_memory: Frozen V2.21 outputs after polarity repair but before stable recent-event source recovery.
comparison_design.plain_recent: Frozen first V2.19 recent-eight-turn direct LLM outputs.
comparison_design.plain_full: Frozen first V2.19 full-transcript direct LLM outputs.

interpretation_rules: The other-person source must be an observed turn containing both the queried object and an explicit relation marker; it may not be invented from the expected answer.
The V2.22 output must preserve queried value, denial polarity, and other-person attribution in the final visible reply.
All LLM baselines and earlier Uruha outputs are frozen references; only V2.22 Uruha outputs are fresh.
This is an exact-case development replay and does not establish independent generalization.
Automatic gates are engineering evidence, not blind human felt-understanding evidence.
